agentSummary: Adds tools for MetaHuman character workflows: Creator face, body and makeup editing, MetaHuman Animator Performance processing as pollable jobs with animation export, and Creator character export (DCC, DNA, geometry, materials, posed DNA on UE 5.8).
enablesAgentTo: Assist with MetaHuman animation and asset setup
Configure, start, poll and cancel MetaHuman Animator Performance processing and export the result as an Animation Sequence or Level Sequence
Export Creator characters as DCC packages, DNA assets or files, skeletal meshes and material instances (UE 5.8)
whenToEnable: Your project uses MetaHuman characters, MetaHuman Animator performances or MetaHuman SDK assets.
